description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

EY is hiring a Financial Services Full Stack Developer for its Service Delivery Center. The role supports client transformation by designing, developing, integrating, testing, deploying, and supporting software applications and technology solutions.
Full-stack software developer building, integrating, testing, and deploying reliable distributed applications for financial services clients

Responsibilities:
• The goal is to support our clients to transform their business problems through engineering solutions
• You will assist engagement teams through the analysis of specific business requirements, design, develop, integrate, test, and deploy distributed software applications
• You will deliver high qualify systems with focus on reliability and excellent customer experience
• You will demonstrate in-depth technical capabilities and professional knowledge

Requirements:
• flexible self-starter
• be able to manage changing priorities and learning new and rapidly changing technology solutions
• Prior fullstack software product development experience
• Deliver engineering solutions through all phases of the project lifecycle, including requirements definition, engineering design, development, integration, and testing; based on a proven agile methodology
• Demonstrate hands-on technical capabilities in multiple programming languages
• Effectively work with client engagement teams with diverse skills and backgrounds fostering an innovative and inclusive work environment
• Demonstrate understanding of current technology environment and industry trends and provide recommendations for engagement and client service issues
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or other related field
• A minimum of 1 year of experience in technology software development
• Back-end experience using modern technologies like Java, Python, Node.js, REST, NoSQL, Microservices, Serverless, and Cloud technologies like AWS, or Azure
• Front-end development with modern frameworks and practices like React, Angular, or Responsive web design
• Experience in designing, building and consuming RESTful APIs
• Hands-on experience building applications/platforms with cloud native/Microservices architecture. Includes experience with IaaS, PaaS, container deployment
• Experience with modern collaborative development tools (e.g. Git, CI/CD pipelines)
• Experience working with testing frameworks and tools for unit and integration testing and knowledge of TDD or BDD software development techniques
• Comfortable working in an Agile and TDD environment
• a self-starter and quick learner with a strong background in computer science from both theoretical and practical points of view

Preferred:
• understanding of DevOps and its supporting services and tools
• Experience with the following technologies

+ Akka/Scala
+ Kafka/RabbitMQ
+ ElasticSearch
+ Hadoop/Spark/Flume
+ Mongo/Cassandra/Any NoSQL DB
